pins.definition: A building or place where trains, buses, or metro trains regularly stop for passengers.
A building and set of tracks where trains stop for passengers to get on and off.
A place where trains or metro trains stop for passengers.

situation: A passenger waiting on a crowded railway platform under a large illuminated departure board.
subject: the station
brief: A red commuter train has stopped beside a concrete platform under a large arched iron roof, and passengers with luggage step through the open carriage doors. A glowing arrivals sign hangs above the tracks, visible against the arched structure of the terminal.
prompt: A red commuter train has stopped beside a concrete platform under a large arched iron roof, and passengers with luggage step through the open carriage doors. A glowing arrivals sign hangs above the tracks, visible against the arched structure of the terminal. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
